ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 95% black/dark gray with localized high-intensity white/light-gray circular and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark-field pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular ring motifs are located on the mid-lateral sections of both lobes. Diffuse light-gray mottling is visible near the median notch and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 40 degrees, extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes (3-8 pixels in depth).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, circular white rings (diameter 5-10 pixels) observed on the left lobe (3 distinct clusters) and right lobe (2 distinct clusters), consistent with parasitic or barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent vertical high-intensity linear mark located on the far left lateral edge, intersecting the pigmentation boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent tan/white calcified or necrotic material encrusting the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, disrupting the smooth geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'double-ring' circular scar constellation on the mid-left lobe.
